title: Extract the long cmd_* report functions in bin/harness.sh

slices.description: Extract cmd_status() into named per-section functions.
steps: Baseline pinned: tests/run.sh green on main and deterministic output snapshots of status/doctor/version captured under .harness-mini/trace/runtime/0062-baseline/ on a temp HARNESS_HOME.
After extraction: tests/run.sh still passes 0 fail and status output is byte-identical to its baseline snapshot.
cmd_status() is a thin dispatcher (<= ~40 lines) over named section functions; no extracted function exceeds ~90 lines; git diff shows only moved code, no changed output strings.

slices.description: Extract cmd_doctor() into named per-check-group functions.
steps: After extraction: tests/run.sh still passes 0 fail and doctor output is byte-identical to its baseline snapshot.
cmd_doctor() is a thin dispatcher (<= ~40 lines) over named check functions; git diff shows only moved code.

slices.description: Extract cmd_update() into named per-step functions.
steps: After extraction: tests/run.sh still passes 0 fail and update/version outputs are byte-identical to their baseline snapshots.
cmd_update() is a thin dispatcher (<= ~40 lines) over named step functions; checksum-guard and .new flow logic unchanged; git diff shows only moved code.
